name: markdown-ocr
title: Markdown OCR
description: Turn a screenshot into Markdown text using Mistral’s next-generation OCR.
author: azilone

commands.name: ocr
commands.title: OCR
commands.subtitle: Turn a screenshot into Markdown
commands.description: Capture a screenshot and extract Markdown text with Mistral OCR.

preferences.name: inputMode
preferences.title: Input
preferences.description: Choose where the image comes from.

preferences.name: mistralOcrModel
preferences.title: Mistral OCR Model
preferences.description: Model name used for OCR requests.

preferences.name: copyResultToClipboard
preferences.title: Output
preferences.label: Copy result to clipboard
preferences.description: Copies the extracted Markdown to clipboard.

preferences.name: pasteResultAfterCopy
preferences.label: Paste result after copy
preferences.description: Pastes into the frontmost app after copying.

preferences.name: playSuccessSound
preferences.title: Feedback
preferences.label: Play success sound
preferences.description: Plays a short system sound when OCR completes successfully.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
